therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: restoration of sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Chronic heart failure patients with left ventricular assist device (LVAD)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Overall safety and feasibility of administering AAV1/SERCA2a to LVAD patients at 6 months

results.target_engagement_evidence: 0 of 4 AAV1/SERCA2a-treated participants showed exogenous viral vector genome in myocardium by qPCR
biomarker_changes: No exogenous viral vector genome detected in myocardium by qPCR in either AAV1/SERCA2a or placebo groups
SERCA2a protein levels not reported due to early termination
Phospholamban, sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release channel, Na+/Ca2+-exchanger levels not reported due to early termination
LVEF and exercise capacity not statistically analyzed due to early termination
safety_signals: Trial terminated early following Trial Steering Committee recommendation after only 5 subjects enrolled
In AAV1/SERCA2a arm (n=4): 1 LVAD alarm, 1 worsening heart failure, 1 heart transplantation, 1 death
Full statistical analysis was impossible due to small sample size

context.indication: chronic heart failure with left ventricular assist device
context.investigator_commentary: Early termination following Trial Steering Committee recommendation. The trial was terminated early with only 5 subjects enrolled. As a result full statistical analysis for both primary and secondary outcomes was impossible and a more pragmatic approach was undertaken to assess product safety.
